item.title: Jump Trading builds new microwave link between Chicago and New Jersey
item.description: Jump Trading is building a new microwave network connecting the CME data center in Aurora to equity exchanges in New Jersey, shaving microseconds off its round trip, filings show.

item.title: Jump Trading hires former Nvidia executive as chief technology officer
item.description: Jump Trading has appointed a former Nvidia vice president of GPU architecture as its new chief technology officer, the firm said on Monday. The hire follows a push into custom hardware.

item.title: Citadel Securities expands colocation footprint at NYSE Mahwah
item.description: Citadel Securities has expanded its colocation footprint at the NYSE data center in Mahwah and added new cross-connects, as market makers race to cut latency.

item.title: Optiver names former Intel VP as head of hardware engineering
item.description: Optiver has named a former Intel vice president of semiconductor design as head of hardware engineering, a newly created role.

item.title: Millennium Management launches new systematic quant strategy
item.description: Millennium Management has launched a new systematic quant strategy team focused on high-frequency futures trading.

item.title: Bridgewater Associates names new head of people
item.description: Bridgewater Associates has named a new head of people and culture, the firm said in a memo to staff.

item.title: Point72 founder buys painting at record auction
item.description: The founder of Point72 Asset Management bought a painting at a record-setting auction in New York this week.

item.title: Renaissance Technologies institutional fund posts gains
item.description: Renaissance Technologies' institutional equities fund posted gains in September, according to a letter to investors.

item.title: Man Group CEO says fee pressure is easing
item.description: Man Group's chief executive said fee pressure across the hedge fund industry is easing as investors return to multi-strategy funds.

item.title: The Citadel military college welcomes record class of cadets
item.description: The Citadel, the military college of South Carolina in Charleston, welcomed a record class of cadets this fall, and announced a new engineering building.

item.title: Chip stocks jump as trading volumes surge
item.description: Semiconductor stocks jump after strong earnings, as trading volumes surge and GPU demand stays high. Investors expect data center buildout to continue.

item.title: New cafe opens on Jane Street in the West Village
item.description: A new cafe has opened at the corner of Jane Street and Hudson Street in Manhattan's West Village, drawing long lines on its first weekend.

item.title: Virtus Investment Partners reports quarterly results
item.description: Virtus Investment Partners, the asset manager, reported quarterly results and said it is investing in low-latency trading infrastructure for its ETFs.
